name: maquetador-dtf
description: Maquetador DTF local con exportación PDF a tamaño real
author: PKprint

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never && node scripts/checksums.mjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
